name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities, including an optional /etc/motd and a Hiera-defined list of utility packages.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys the full Python application stack for myapp-api, including dependencies, PostgreSQL integration, systemd service management, and monitoring/logging.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer with listeners, statistics, SSL settings, logging, firewall rules, health checks, and backend definitions.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL, including the PGDG repository, version-pinned packages, and database service management.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures a Redis cluster and discovers participating nodes through PuppetDB.
